text:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick org update — Growth & Monetization will split into two teams: Product Growth (experimentation, acquisition, PM-led) and Revenue Ops (pricing, billing telemetry, monetization infra). Effective Mon 2025-03-08. Evan Carter will act as interim Head of Revenue Ops while we run a short backfill + hiring surge.
Diego Morales: +1. Thanks Aisha — strategic move. Can we get the new reporting lines and who owns the roadmap handoff?
Aisha (People Ops): Yes — short version: Product Growth reports into Diego. Revenue Ops reports into the Revenue org (matrix to Product for shared roadmaps). I'll post the org chart update in the drive.
Evan Carter: Happy to take this on for the transition. Will run a 30/60/90 plan + weekly sync with existing Growth PMs. Will set up a recurring Thu 9am starting this week.
Priya Natarajan: Any implications for runtime or dedicated infra requests? Need to know if we should re-route tickets during the handoff.
Evan Carter: Priya — we'll own the monetization infra backlog, but runtime/infra SLAs stay with Eng Runtime. I'll add a mapping doc.
Jordan Kim: I'll open the reqs today. Priority hires for Revenue Ops: Senior Data Engineer (backfill), Staff ML Infra Engineer (new role), Revenue Ops Manager. Target to have at least 2 offers out within 6 weeks.
Lizzy Mendoza: I'll update the org chart and the People directory. Also prepping an all-hands blurb for next Tue so customer-facing teams get aligned.
Mariam Okoye: Noted for Private deployments customers — I'll coordinate comms if any changes affect account teams.
Hiring Bot: New job postings created: /jobs/SDENG-789, /jobs/MLINFRA-234, /jobs/ROPS-101. Candidate pipeline will be tracked in Notion.
Aisha (People Ops): Timeline summary:
- Today: announce split (this thread).
- By EOD: open reqs and post JDs.
- Next 2 weeks: screen + interviews.
- 6 weeks: target offers for top-priority roles.

Aisha (People Ops): Sample JD snippet (short):
```
Senior Data Engineer, Revenue Ops
- 5+ yrs experience building ETL pipelines and revenue telemetry
- SQL + Python, experience with Kafka/streaming a plus
- Responsible for building pricing/usage metrics and ingestion for billing
```

Diego Morales: Thank you team. Evan — lean on Jordan and Lizzy for interview loops. Aisha — please escalate any org-edging issues to me.
Evan Carter: Will do. Quick ask — can People Ops prioritize sourcing for diverse slates? We want to move fast but thoughtfully.
Aisha (People Ops): Absolutely — we'll share the sourcing plan in the tracker and tag the priority reqs.
Jordan Kim: I'll post short role descriptions in #eng-recruiting and ping talent partners.
Lizzy Mendoza: Sending updated org chart + comms draft by EOD. Will include a short FAQ for common manager/IC questions.
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If you have questions or need to escalate exceptions, DM me or drop them here. :sparkles:
